note: Mountrail County Park Board recreation area on a point in the northeast corner of Lake Sakakawea's Van Hook Arm, run by a concessionaire: three sections of open, lightly treed loops with three boat ramps, fish-cleaning stations and a pavilion. 34 electric sites go to seasonal campers. --Claude
summary: County park site read: 100+ sites in three sections, full hookup $32 / water+electric $28 / electric $26 / primitive RV $17 (first come), Campspot booking, open May 15-Sep 15, showers and 7 vault toilets, 34 seasonal electric sites. Fees/booking/season/hookups/facilities written manual. Pin is ~1.45 km off (open shore west of the bay) - move. Lakefront -> lakeview lead (no nameable nightly pad within 50 m; old evidence was taken at the wrong pin).
flags: PIN: stored 47.9177,-102.3128 sits on open sandy shore and scrub west of the bay with no campground; the campground fills the point to the east, centre ~47.9220,-102.2945 (Google 47.92021,-102.29360 is its entrance on 35th St NW). Move ~1.45 km; elevation_meters should be re-pinned with it.

WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview (lead). The stored evidence ('camping loops on the point ... at 47.9177,-102.3128') was taken at the wrong pin. No site map or site numbers are available (Campspot shows the resort closed for 2027 and lists no types). On imagery the loops are open ground on the point with the bay in view on three sides; the nearest identifiable pads, the angled pull-throughs on the north edge (~47.9235,-102.2932), sit ~60-85 m from the vegetated high-water edge, the east loop is inside the perimeter road along the shore (~47.9226,-102.2862), and the west knoll (~47.9226,-102.2955) holds only shelters above a shrub-lined slope to the beach. No nightly pad can be placed within ~50 m over open ground; the 34 seasonal electric sites are not identified.

LONG-STAY: 34 electric sites in a May 15-Sep 15 'Seasonal Program' out of 'over 100 campsites' (HHS: 116 units) - roughly a third seasonal; nightly rates posted and booked online. Passes; the stored note's '12 long-term/seasonal spots reservable' is wrong and is replaced.

OWNERSHIP: local stands. The site is 'Mountrail County Parks' and HHS licenses 'MOUNTRAIL COUNTY'; Campspot's legal name 'Parshall Bay Rec Area LLC ... d/b/a Parshall Bay Recreational Area' shows a concessionaire operating it.
HOOKUPS: electric amperage is not posted (full hookup, electric+water and electric-only sites exist); left unset.
